explanation: I searched Mathlib/Topology/Semicontinuity for inv/neg versions of the semicontinuity lemmas. I also grepped all of Mathlib for LowerSemicontinuous or UpperSemicontinuous applied to a negation or inverse. The only matches were the lemmas in the same file: the WithinAt, At and On variants, and the aliases `UpperSemicontinuous.inv` and `LowerSemicontinuous.inv`, which come from this theorem and its sibling. I found no independent declaration with the same content.
